Add a unique touch of natural beauty to your home decor with this quartz crystal flame and geode pair. The collection includes one carved rose quartz flame, featuring flowing natural patterns, soft pink coloring, and a sculptural form that stands out as a decorative accent. The stone's curved and polished surfaces create gentle reflections, making it a soothing focal point for any room. Alongside the flame, you'll find a matching pair of quartz geode halves, showcasing rough exteriors and sparkling crystal interiors with intricate formations and a grayish hue. These natural mineral pieces serve beautifully as desk ornaments, shelf displays, or as thoughtful gifts for collectors and enthusiasts of earth's wonders. Each item is in good condition, showing minor surface marks consistent with gentle handling. The pairing of the carved flame and natural geodes brings a harmonious blend of artistry and authenticity to any space

Walt Disney Collectables
Mickey Mouse Through the Years 6 Souvenir Pens
National Pen Corporation, Circa 1986
Vintage Walt Disney Collectables six-piece souvenir pen set manufactured in the United States by National Pen Corporation. Produced around 1986 during the transition from Walt Disney Productions to The Walt Disney Company, this commemorative set highlights the artistic evolution of Mickey Mouse across six signature animation eras.
Complete set of six souvenir pens featuring Mickey Mouse designs from 1928, 1936, 1941, 1947, 1955, and 1986
Manufactured in the USA by National Pen Corporation with chrome-tone pocket clips marked USA National Pen
Front display card bears original Walt Disney Productions copyright, while pen barrels feature The Walt Disney Company copyright
Housed in original hanging blister display case measuring approximately 6.8 by 6.4 inches
Condition:
Unopened in original plastic blister case. Packaging displays age-appropriate yellowing, light scuffing, and an original $7.50 retail price sticker on the reverse. Pens are preserved in place; writing functionality is untested and ink cartridges may be dried due to vintage age.
